test_simple_heuristic_model_univariate: test the SimpleHeuristicModel with univariate time series data using last, mean, median, and percentile methods
run_simple_heuristic_model_last: run the SimpleHeuristicModel with the last method to forecast using the most recent values
run_simple_heuristic_model_mean: run the SimpleHeuristicModel with the mean method to forecast using historical mean values
run_simple_heuristic_model_percentile: run the SimpleHeuristicModel with the percentile method and a custom quantile parameter for forecasting
review_simple_heuristic_model_params: review the SimpleHeuristicModelParams class to understand method and quantile parameter validation
